title: Pear with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pearBody' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8f55a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#b8d930'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7aaa1e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='pearTop' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4ea4a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8bbb25'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Pear body: wider bottom, narrower top -->
  <path d='M50 22
           C42 22, 34 28, 32 36
           C30 44, 34 50, 30 58
           C26 66, 22 72, 24 80
           C26 88, 36 94, 50 94
           C64 94, 74 88, 76 80
           C78 72, 74 66, 70 58
           C66 50, 70 44, 68 36
           C66 28, 58 22, 50 22Z'
        fill='url(#pearBody)' stroke='#a8c92a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Highlight on body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#f2ff8a' opacity='0.35' transform='rotate(-15 40 48)'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d='M50 22 C50 16, 48 10, 52 6' fill='none' stroke='#8a5a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 22 C50 17, 49 12, 51 8' fill='none' stroke='#a86e24' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Leaf -->
  <path d='M52 10 C58 4, 70 4, 74 10 C68 14, 58 14, 52 10Z' fill='#4cc23a' stroke='#2f9e1e' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M54 10 C60 8, 66 8, 70 10' fill='none' stroke='#2f9e1e' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Blush cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='66' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Eyes: happy closed arcs -->
  <path d='M38 58 Q41 53, 44 58' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a0a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 58 Q59 53, 62 58' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a0a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M42 70 Q50 80, 58 70' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a0a' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tongue hint -->
  <path d='M46 73 Q50 77, 54 73' fill='#ff6a6a' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- Little blush lines -->
  <line x1='30' y1='64' x2='28' y2='67' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='64' x2='72' y2='67' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
